items.title: Gilead Sciences (GILD) Posts PURPOSE 5 Win As HIV Shot Beats Daily Pills
items.summary: Gilead Sciences (NasdaqGS:GILD) reported PURPOSE 5 trial data showing twice-yearly injectable lenacapavir for HIV prevention outperformed daily oral PrEP on persistence. The PURPOSE 5 study found higher adherence and zero HIV infections in the lenacapavir group compared with oral prevention medicines. Researchers described PURPOSE 5 as the first trial built to directly compare long acting injectable PrEP against daily oral HIV prevention regimens. The superior persistence and zero HIV cases...
